newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss '97 joblessness to average 5.3 pct '97 -BIGA.
newsitem.headline: Swiss '97 joblessness to average 5.3 pct '97 -BIGA.

text.p: Switzerland's unemployment rate is expected to average 5.3 percent in 1997, the head of the country's Federal Labour Office (BIGA) told the Tages-Anzeiger newspaper in an interview published on Friday.

"We expect 5.3 percent," BIGA director Jean-Luc Nordmann said when asked about a UBS forecast that the average jobless rate would be 5.5 percent this year. "We expect the number of jobless to average around 195,000 over the year."
This could drop to 185,000 in 1998 and toward 100,000 within five years, he added. The jobless rate stood at 5.1 percent in June, when 185,320 were out of work.
